name: The Weaver
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Ataeric works to wake a dormant ley node for Dalaran. At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister sends you to stop the archmage and take his staff, lest Dalaran’s magic threaten Forsaken control of southern Lordaeron.

sections.title: Severing the Ley Thread
sections.body: After your earlier inquiries into Ambermill and Dalaran’s movements, the Forsaken learned that its wizards seek to wake a dormant ley energy node in Silverpine Forest. Dalaran could draw on that concentrated arcane power to strengthen its position and threaten the Undercity’s hold over southern Lordaeron.

sections.title: The Archmage's Fall
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister knows the work must end at its source. Archmage Ataeric directs it, guarded by wards and fellow magi. Slay him and take his staff, and the gathered magic scatters. The ley energies grow dormant again, thwarting the Kirin Tor’s plans in the valley.

faq.answer: Archmage Ataeric is the Weaver, a powerful Dalaran spellcaster in Silverpine Forest. He seeks to join and awaken the latent ley energies beneath the area.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want the archmage killed?
faq.answer: The Forsaken fear Dalaran will draw vast arcane power from the dormant ley node near the Undercity. Shadow Priest Allister sees that as a threat to Forsaken sovereignty and orders Ataeric killed before the node fully awakens.

faq.q: What happens after Ataeric is defeated?
faq.answer: When Ataeric is slain and you take his staff, the arcane network collapses. The gathered spells dissipate and the ley line grows dormant again, leaving the Kirin Tor without its chief foothold of arcane power in southern Silverpine.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister sends you from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He gives the order after examining earlier intelligence about Dalaran’s presence around Ambermill.

faq.q: What is the significance of Ataeric's staff?
faq.answer: Archmage Ataeric’s staff focuses and channels the region’s ley energies. Taking it ensures the magic unravels completely and gives Allister an artifact he may study for the Forsaken’s own designs.

faq.q: Where does Dalaran's presence in Silverpine come from?
aliases: why are dalaran mages in silverpine
faq.answer: Though Dalaran was devastated during the Third War, remnants of the Kirin Tor keep fortified enclaves, outposts, and arcane experiments in nearby territories such as Ambermill. They seek to regain control and harness vital magical reserves.

angles.text: As an Undead, you face Dalaran’s living magi, who dispute Forsaken control over the ruins of Lordaeron. Stopping their archmage helps secure the Sepulcher’s perimeter.
As a Mage, you know ley lines demand deep mastery of arcane geometry. Ataeric’s fall shows how delicate such rituals become when their main conduits are lost.
As a Priest, you see Shadow Priest Allister direct this operation with cold resolve, seeking to extinguish an arcane catalyst before it grows in power.
As a member of the Horde, you face Dalaran’s hostile remnants. Any growth in their arcane strength threatens Horde lands in northern Lordaeron.
